## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change, and `cargo fmt`, clippy, tests and `cargo deny` pass.
- [ ] The docs are updated where behaviour changes.
- [ ] No private infrastructure details (hostnames, addresses, user names).
- [ ] Changes to auth, sessions, tokens, policy, secrets or outbound HTTP have a
      security review recorded below.
- [ ] `Cargo.lock` additions are at least 7 days old (the `crate-age` check).
